measured_frozen_contract_footprint.root_depth_convention: root value has depth 0; each contained value increments depth by 1; object member names are not values
measured_frozen_contract_footprint.measurement_rule: parse only after strict UTF-8 validation and duplicate-preserving object-pair construction; count the root and every object, array, string, number, boolean or null as one value node

fixed_ingress_resource_bounds.allocation_rule: every input, token, decoded string, object-pair vector, array vector and canonical-output allocation is checked against its fixed ceiling before growth; no unchecked size addition or multiplication
fixed_ingress_resource_bounds.recursion_rule: recursive descent may enter at most depth 8 and must fail before constructing a depth-9 value
fixed_ingress_resource_bounds.exhaustion_rule: first exhausted counter is terminal C08-002 failure; no retry, larger buffer, alternate parser, alternate root, retune or deletion

wire_and_canonicalization.raw_whitespace_rule: RFC8259 JSON whitespace is syntactically permitted before or after the single value, including the exact frozen file's terminal LF; the exact raw byte count and SHA-256 still reject every whitespace mutation
wire_and_canonicalization.single_value_rule: exactly one JSON value; every non-whitespace trailing byte is rejected
wire_and_canonicalization.duplicate_rule: decode object member names to Unicode scalar sequences, reject duplicates before object construction, including direct-versus-escaped aliases
wire_and_canonicalization.surrogate_rule: reject every unpaired high or low UTF-16 surrogate; a paired escape decodes to one Unicode scalar value; no Unicode normalization
wire_and_canonicalization.contract_key_rule: every object member name is nonempty printable ASCII bytes 0x20 through 0x7e after decoding
wire_and_canonicalization.number_rule: valid JSON number grammar, finite IEEE-754 binary64 value, negative zero canonicalizes to 0, and every integer-valued resource field lies in [-(2^53-1),2^53-1]
wire_and_canonicalization.canonicalization: RFC8785-compatible JCS with object names ordered by UTF-16 code units, minimal JSON string escaping, lowercase literals and ECMAScript shortest finite-number serialization
wire_and_canonicalization.canonicalization_order: parse into duplicate-preserving pairs, validate duplicates and all semantic/resource rules, construct the value, then serialize canonically

hash_bindings.raw_algorithm: SHA-256 of exact file bytes with no domain prefix
hash_bindings.self_member_rule: C08-021, not C08-002, hashes UTF-8(domain)||RFC8785(value with only the relevant self-hash member omitted); this proposal does not change that inherited rule

ordered_validation_and_failure_precedenc: 001 reject raw byte count above 65536 before allocation or decode
002 reject BOM, then reject invalid UTF-8 at the least raw byte offset
003 lex exactly one JSON value and reject invalid escapes, unpaired surrogates, invalid number grammar or non-whitespace trailing bytes
004 parse into pair-preserving objects while enforcing depth, node, member, element, string, key, cumulative-string and number-lexeme counters before growth
005 reject the least canonical-path duplicate decoded object key before constructing any object map
006 reject the least canonical-path empty or non-printable-ASCII contract key
007 reject the least canonical-path nonfinite binary64 number or unsafe integer-valued resource field
008 require root object, exact raw byte count 54972 and exact raw SHA-256
010 require exact canonical byte count 49780 and exact domain-separated canonical SHA-256
within_step_tie_rule: choose the least raw byte offset when defined, then the lexicographically least RFC8785 canonical JSON Pointer path encoded with RFC6901 escapes, then the listed predicate order
